title: Prior-shift diagnostic: how much of language-model forgetting is a context-free logit correction?
description: Code and per-document data for a diagnostic that measures how much of a derived language model's cross-entropy increase on old-distribution web text is recovered by a context-free logit correction (a token-prior bias, a temperature, or both), measured symmetrically against the base model given the same correction. Fourteen released base/derived pairs (OLMo-2, Qwen2.5, SmolLM2), including continued-pretraining pairs. The data hold document hashes, token counts and per-document loss sums only, no corpus text. See README.md.
